results.title: Israel player Sayed Abu Farchi sent off for goal celebration in Nations League
results.description: LINZ, Austria (AP) — Israel player Sayed Abu Farchi was sent off for his goal-scoring celebration after equalizing against Austria in the Nations League on Thursday.

results.title: Kyle Juszczyk gets fined for chugging celebration that NFL says was beer and he says was juice
results.description: SANTA CLARA, Calif. (AP) — The NFL fined San Francisco 49ers All-Pro fullback Kyle Juszczyk for what it deemed an “offensive” celebration similar to one he had been doing for several years with no issues.
